query: Current BMEX BitMEX token price, market cap, and circulating supply on CoinGecko as of late July 2026, and recent daily price history since July 23 2026 crash
answer:
Research complete. Here's a summary of my findings on BMEX (BitMEX Token) as of late July 2026:

## Current Snapshot (CoinGecko, ~July 28, 2026)
- **Price:** ~$0.002292 USD
- **Market cap:** ~$228,600 (rank ~#4,098)
- **Circulating supply:** 99.75M BMEX
- **Total / Max supply:** 450M BMEX each
- **FDV:** ~$1.03M
- **24h volume:** ~$4,360 (very thin)
- **All-time high:** $1.29 (Nov 12, 2022) — ~99.8% below ATH
- **All-time low:** $0.001731 (set July 27, 2026, during this crash)

## The Crash & Daily History
BitMEX announced on **July 23, 2026** that it would permanently shut down (closure September 23, 2026, 04:00 UTC; registrations halted immediately). This crashed the token:

| Date | Close | Market Cap |
|---|---|---|
| Jul 22 | $0.059876 | $6.09M |
| Jul 23 | $0.005348 | ~$6M→sub-$1M |
| Jul 24 | $0.004061 | $533K |
| Jul 25 | $0.003774 | $405K |
| Jul 26 | $0.002528 | $376K |
| Jul 27 | ~$0.0017–0.0023 | $228–252K |

The single-day drop (Jul 22→23) was ~91%; news outlets cite a ~98% plunge within hours.

## ⚠️ Key Data Caveat
CoinGecko's headline **"7d change" showed +96.3%, which is a data glitch** — contradicted by its own 7-day range ($0.001731–$0.06117), the daily close history, and MEXC's **-96.24%** 7-day figure. The token unambiguously **crashed ~96% over the week**, not rallied. Any downstream analysis should ignore the erroneous positive figure.

This was part of a broader exchange consolidation wave — BitMart announced its own shutdown days later (its BMX token fell ~70%).
